name: claude-code-templates
description: Component templates and tracking system for Claude Code

scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run validate && npm run build
scripts.agent:security-auditor: security-auditor 'Security audit covering codebase, dependencies, and deployment configuration'
scripts.bun:check: bun --version || echo 'Bun not installed. Visit https://bun.sh/'
scripts.pm:detect: node -e "require('./cli-tool/src/utils/package-manager').detectPackageManager({ verbose: true }).then(pm => console.log('✓ Detected:', pm.displayName, 'v' + pm.version)).catch(e => console.error('✗ Error:', e.message))"

author: involvex
